requirement: Move/upgrade/extend: staff can perform a room-type upgrade during an in-house stay, with capacity, prior money/history and authority preserved

observations.fact: checkRoom requires actual room type equal to supplied stay type
stay.assign/stay.move call checkRoom with unchanged r.data.typeId and only modify roomId/room segments
stay.change_dates reprices against unchanged r.data.typeId; cannot change room type
stay.replace is signed booking service only and requires reserved state; it does not cover in-house upgrade
Existing move/extend case adds target room with same type; it does not prove cross-type in-house upgrade

scopeLimits: Reserved booking revision may already permit a future room-type change; this gap is specifically in-house staff room-type upgrade.
A move/extend passing native case does not establish upgrade acceptance.
No production source, test, config or live transactions were changed by this audit.

Prove target inventory and inspected room, immutable consumed-night prices/issued money/room history, current/future capacity, group/direct-booking policy, replay and refusal boundaries.
Expose upgrade in right drawer and verify normal desktop/mobile journey on newly aligned candidate; rerun final same-candidate gates.
